kept.claim: `_header.html.erb` wraps `.title`/`.panel` in `.row`, so the new flex rules don't reach them. Removing the floats breaks the server-rendered header (no_ember pages, noscript). On mobile the login button stacks under the logo. On desktop `.span13` still floats the title left at 59.8%, so the button moves from the far right to about 60% across.
kept.body: ## [ISSUE] Server-rendered header loses its layout: `.title`/`.panel` are not flex items there **Severity:** MEDIUM — on `no_ember` pages and in the `
kept.evidence: The regression is real, but the claim that nothing styles `.span13` is wrong for desktop. The diff (header.scss:14-19, 35-40) removes the `.title` and `.panel` floats and makes `.contents` the flex container. _header.html.erb:4-18 wraps `.title.span13` and `.panel` in a `.row`, so they are not flex items. The partial is rendered by layouts/no_ember.html.erb:22 and inside <noscript> in application.html.erb:40. On desktop, desktop/discourse.scss:496-499 floats `.span13` left at 59.8% width, so the login button (float:left, header.scss:42) stays on the logo's line but about 60% across instead of at the far right. On mobile, nothing positions `.span13`, so the panel stacks under the logo, left-aligned. `.row` has only a clearfix (foundation/base.scss:91-95).

kept.claim: Making `.small-action` a flex container without `flex: 1` on `.small-action-desc` shrink-wraps the description, so its `float: right` edit/delete buttons now sit next to the text instead of at the right edge of the row.
kept.evidence: topic-post.scss:263-265 makes `.small-action` flex. `.small-action-desc` (279-302) has no flex-grow or width, so it defaults to `flex: 0 1 auto` and shrinks to its max-content width. small-action.hbs:2-8 places the edit/delete buttons inside the desc with `float: right` (topic-post.scss:305-309), so they float within the shrunk box, not at the right edge of the 755px row (desktop/topic-post.scss:730). No other stylesheet restores the width.

kept.claim: Cutting `.small-action-desc` left padding from 4em to 1.5% leaves mobile's `.custom-message { margin-left: -40px }` (mobile/topic-post.scss:520), which was sized to cancel that padding, pulling custom small-action messages outside the description box and over the icon.
kept.evidence: mobile/topic-post.scss:516-523 keeps `.custom-message { margin-left: -40px }`, and the diff doesn't touch it. The old `padding-left: 4em` (about 50px) absorbed that margin. The new `padding: 0 1.5%` (topic-post.scss:280) together with the flex layout (the desc now starts after the 45px icon column, and floats are ignored) moves the message about 35px left of the desc box into the icon column. Nothing clips it (no overflow:hidden). This affects mobile only.

dropped.claim: The `align-items` mixin copies its argument unchanged into `-webkit-box-align` and `-ms-flex-align`, which only take `start`/`end` (not `flex-start`/`flex-end`), and emits `-ms-align-items`, which no browser supports, so any future `align-items(flex-start)` call is silently dropped on the prefixed engines.
dropped.evidence: mixins.scss:117-123 maps the value 1:1 onto legacy properties and emits the non-existent -ms-align-items, but every current caller passes center or baseline (header.scss:18, topic-post.scss:265, badges.css.scss:57), and those keywords are valid in every syntax. -ms-align-items is ignored harmlessly. It only breaks for a hypothetical future flex-start/flex-end caller.

dropped.claim: The `order` mixin passes its value straight to `-webkit-box-ordinal-group`/`-moz-box-ordinal-group`, which need an integer of at least 1 (default 1, while `order` defaults to 0), so `order(0)` or a negative order is invalid in the legacy syntax and ordering against default items drifts by one.
dropped.evidence: mixins.scss:125-131 does have the 0-based vs 1-based off-by-one, but the only callers are order(2) (topic.scss:30) and order(3) (header.scss:39) next to an unordered .title. The modern order (0<2<3) and the legacy order (1<2<3) give the same visual order. Nothing calls order(0), order(1) or order(-1).
